name: coding-style
description: Cross-domain code + environment conventions, independent of any app stack: lint-format (language-agnostic tooling floor), brevity (a line must inform or go — comments, commits, PRs; plus which anti-verbosity rules are model-version debt), no-iteration-narration (comments describe the final model, not the path), ts-style (TS/JS house style on Biome or eslint), svelte (Svelte + SvelteKit style), npm-release (versioning and publishing the npm libraries), and fish (Eetu's default shell — gotchas, and bash -c one-liners for anything handed over).
